prompt: Evaluate this repository's GitHub Actions CI-workflow maturity and report findings with a score. Do not change anything.
setup: There is one workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml that parses as valid YAML.
It uses a third-party action pinned to a movable major tag (uses: some-org/some-action@v3) rather than a full commit SHA.
It sets permissions: write-all at the workflow top level.
Its single build job has no timeout-minutes.
expected: The report flags the unpinned action (unpinned-action), the write-all grant (overly-permissive-permissions), and the job without a timeout (ci-workflow-job-missing-timeout).
Each finding cites the workflow file and the offending line or job.
A maturity score is shown as a percentage with the failing and relevant weight totals.
Every CI finding is presented as report-only with a manual remediation.
must_not: Modify the workflow, any file, or Git state during evaluation.
Resolve the action tag to a commit SHA or contact any remote.
Claim a rule passed that was not evaluated.
Apply an automatic fix to any CI-workflow rule.
